findings.issue: Marked Cross-document with 'no story-side text change', but section 14 MSG-P1-001 now carries the Error and Message Standard v4 text.
Disposition note says section 16 test case rows remain to add, but TC-AD-018-05 to 07-ITG are in the story.
Note says section 16 rows are not added, but they are. BR9 'Covered by' cites exception X9 instead of criterion AC9.
AC8 has the monitor composed in the run, which contradicts section 1: the harness composes nothing of its own.
'Freshness answer is served here' contradicts the story: this harness serves nothing; P1 rwb-source-data serves the freshness read.
New Pending row states timing and absent duration and check results for PENDING, which the story and disposition do not support.
Section 11 closing text still says P1's job read answers the catalog row, against the new rule that catalog fields come only through P2's contract.
Outbound row says the rows are read only through P1's job read and also through a contract mock; it also has the harness 'show' them.
Section 11 says that until P1 publishes the schemas, fields are asserted from the published contract, which is self-contradictory.
